notes: Eligibility (library-API alignment precondition across the kobuki_bumper2pc<->eigen boundary), elements (api:Eigen::Vector4f + api:EIGEN_MAKE_ALIGNED_OPERATOR_NEW), and loudness loud_documented/activate (Eigen's own assertion at plugin construction) all agree; the fix commit 18b46dc adds EIGEN_MAKE_ALIGNED_OPERATOR_NEW to Bumper2PcNodelet. Two disagreements: (1) class — the JSON field says 'representation_convention' but the spec's own notes say 'The condition is an ABI/alignment precondition of the library API (no class in the list fits exactly; recorded as other)'. Alignment is not component/byte order, handedness, or encoding, so 'other' is correct. (2) resolution — the spec says 'observed', but 'observed' requires the source to show the resolved composition working with both units identified by revision. The evidence is corot's statement 'solves the problem' (fix-author claim, same day as the commit) and jorge's 'We fixed it and released just now', while the spec's own notes admit 'The reporter (CarolineQ) did not post a confirmation; the Eigen revision of the maintainers' 32-bit test machine is not stated'. Neither unit's resolved revision is shown working, so 'recommended' (accepted/merged but not shown working in this composition) is correct.
